notes: First /thesis build for CEG. The core tension this quarter: fundamentals (Q1 2026 beat, reaffirmed full-year guide, both the 2026/27 AND 2028/29 PJM capacity auctions already cleared at/near the $325/MW-day cap) have DIVERGED from price (down ~36% from the Oct 2025 ATH of $412, hitting a fresh 52-week low of $228.63 on Jul 1, 2026). The proximate cause of the July selloff was a Citi price-target cut (to $297 from $348) explicitly citing a PJM reliability-reform MEETING, not a confirmed rule change or a company-specific miss — this is a live, unresolved policy-risk repricing, not a closed dislocation, which is why the bear case here carries a higher starting probability weight (20%) than a typical earnings-driven bear case in this dashboard series. Valuation ruler chosen: adjusted operating EPS x forward P/E (NOT GAAP EPS, which is heavily distorted by mark-to-market hedge accounting — GAAP diluted EPS fell from $11.89 in 2024 to $7.40 in 2025 despite adjusted operating EPS growing from a smaller 2022-23 base to $9.39). CEG's own trading history is short (spun off from Exelon Feb 2022), so THE PAST tab covers only 4 fiscal years (2022-2025) and the reverse-DCF/multiple-band judgment has less full-cycle precedent to lean on than a longer-listed peer like TSM.
